abstract: We describe our experience with BEP (bleomycin, etoposide, cisplatin) therapy as chemotherapy for testicular tumors in 11 patients. Eight were non-seminomatous testicular cancer patients and 3 were seminoma patients. Three of 8 non-seminomatous testicular cancer patients had no evident metastasis and BEP therapy was performed for prophylaxis of recurrence. Other 5 non-seminomatous testicular cancer patients and 3 seminoma patients had metastatic lesions and BEP therapy was performed to cure these metastatic lesions. Ten of our 11 patients are living and disease-free. One non-seminomatous testicular cancer patient who had brain, lung, eye and bladder metastases and had an extremely elevated human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) level responded only partially and died later due to disease progression. Side effects in most patients were nausea, vomiting, alopecia and leucopenia and all these side effects were reversible. Neuromuscular toxicity such as paresthesia or abdominal cramp that is sometimes encountered in PVB (cisplatin, vinblastine, bleomycin) therapy was not seen in our patients. Our results support the concept that BEP therapy is better than PVB therapy as an initial chemotherapy for testicular tumors.
abstract_ja: 精巣腫瘍の患者11例に対するBEP療法(ブレオマイシン、エトポシド、シスプラチン)の経験を報告する。非セミノーマ性精巣がん8例、セミノーマ3例であった。非セミノーマ性精巣がん8例のうち3例は明らかな転移はなく、再発予防目的でBEP療法を実施した。非セミノーマ性精巣がん5例とセミノーマ3例は転移病変を有し、転移病変の治癒を目的にBEP療法を実施した。11例中10例は無病生存中である。脳、肺、眼、膀胱に転移があり、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)値が著明に高値であった非セミノーマ性精巣がん1例は部分奏効のみで、後に病勢進行により死亡した。ほとんどの患者で、悪心、嘔吐、脱毛、白血球減少がみられたが、いずれも可逆的であった。PVB療法(シスプラチン、ビンブラスチン、ブレオマイシン)で時にみられる神経筋毒性(感覚異常や腹部痙攣)は本患者群ではみられなかった。われわれの結果は、精巣腫瘍に対する初回化学療法としてBEP療法がPVB療法より優れるという考えを支持する。
